blurb: Ian Taylor Trekking offers guided trekking and mountaineering trips including Everest Base Camp, Kilimanjaro, Inca Trail, Cotopaxi, Chimborazo, Mount Toubkal, K2 Base Camp, and Denali. They provide tailored training courses in Colorado to prepare clients for high-altitude and technical climbs. The company emphasizes safety, acclimatization, expert guides, and community support in their trips.

quotes.author: Kylie Sutton
quotes.text: I have just arrived home from the most memorable trip to Macchu Picchu. From the first second we arrived we were in the very capable hands of our wonderful guides Percy and Edson. Our team of porters were incredible, and the scenery was beyond beautiful every step of the way. Machu Picchu was more incredible than I had imagined. Walking through the sun gates to see Machu Picchu at sunset, then again as the sun was rising through the mist at dawn the next morning, was absolutely magical. Thank you so much to Ian Taylor Trekking, we're already talking about our next adventure!

quotes.author: Mike Connor
quotes.text: We just returned from: (I) a successful summit of Kilimanjaro via an eight-day hike up the Lemosho Route; followed by (II) a safari to the Tarangire, Ngorongoro and Serengeti parks. All of it was organized and led by Ian Taylor Trekking (“ITT”). We had a fantastic time! The plans and guide teams on the mountain and on safari were exceptional — the best available, in my opinion. Highly recommended. I would hire ITT over any other guide groups out there! The pre trip training advice was invaluable. Mike

quotes.author: Cindy Farris Crochet
quotes.text: Kilimanjaro was the experience of a lifetime because of Ian Taylor Trekking. Athumani and his team of guides and porters were all caring and professional. I had no doubts about my safety and my ability to reach the top. Every night in the dining tent was fun and the food was amazingly delicious! This is a group of professionals - I would book a trip with them any time.

quotes.author: Mairtín Óg McDonagh
quotes.text: Just back in Ireland after a successful summit of Aconcagua with Ian Taylor Trekking. Like all my other trips with ITT this was brilliant from start to finish. Professional & well organised. Top class guides & facilities. You just prepare yourself as instructed & turn up in good shape. ITT look after the rest so you can enjoy the journey.

quotes.author: Kate Loar
quotes.text: I climbed Kilimanjaro in October 2023 with Ian Taylor Trekking, and there aren't words to adequately describe the quality of this team. From the preparation, to the food, to the equipment, to the guides and team, everything was exceptional. I wouldn't climb with any other team!

quotes.author: Mal Cooke
quotes.text: Everything about our Kilimanjaro experience with Ian Taylor Trekking was first rate. They gave us great info before to ensure we were well prepared and the experience on the mountain was pure class. Safe, fun, well supported. Forever grateful
